result.description: Cloud-based business phone and call-center platform with calls, SMS/messaging, contacts, and AI conversation intelligence.
result.auth_detail: Basic Auth with API ID + token generated in the Aircall Dashboard for a single account (private apps). OAuth 2.0 only for approved tech partners building public apps; credentials are issued after partner approval.
result.access_detail: Basic API keys are self-serve from the dashboard of an existing Aircall account (no plan restriction found in docs; role and plan not stated). OAuth for multi-customer apps needs Tech Partner Program application plus review (1-5 business days). Composio-style multi-tenant toolkit needs OAuth, so it needs partner approval.
result.api_notes: REST at api.aircall.io/v1 plus webhooks. Resource groups: users, teams, calls (search, transfer, comment, tag, recordings), conversations, conversation intelligence, messaging (SMS/WhatsApp), contacts, tags, numbers, campaigns, AI voice agent, analytics exports, company, integrations. Rate limit 120 req/min. Some features (AI Assist, Analytics+, AI voice agent) are entitlement-gated.
result.blocker: Single-account API-key toolkit buildable now. Multi-tenant OAuth needs Aircall Tech Partner Program approval. No official Aircall-hosted MCP server found (Aircall consumes partner MCPs instead).

evidence.quote: Aircall supports two ways to authenticate with the REST API: Basic Authentication and OAuth.
Basic Authentication lets you authenticate requests with an `API ID` and `token` that you generate from your Aircall Dashboard.
OAuth is required for public apps.
If approved, you'll receive your developer account and OAuth credentials to start building
Aircall Public API is a classic REST API.
Registering an MCP with Aircall makes your tools and resources available to every Aircall AI customer
This MCP server is NOT built, maintained, or endorsed by Aircall.
